items.zh: 模型调用、工具权限和部署成本仍需单独评估。
items.en: Evaluate model usage, tool permissions and deployment costs separately.

items.zh: 采购或集成时核对具体服务的区域、账户、费用、数据处理与支持条件。
items.en: For purchasing or integration, check the exact service's regions, accounts, costs, data handling and support terms.

summary.zh: OpenAI 的编码 Agent，可在本地仓库中检查文件、修改代码并运行开发工具，也有 IDE 与云端入口。
summary.en: OpenAI's coding agent inspects files, edits code and runs local development tools, with IDE and cloud entry points.

capabilities.zh: 并行处理软件工程任务
capabilities.en: Parallel software engineering tasks

capabilities.zh: 代码库任务执行与测试
capabilities.en: Repository task execution and testing

capabilities.zh: 隔离执行环境
capabilities.en: Isolated execution environments

introduction.zh: OpenAI 的编码 Agent，可在本地仓库中检查文件、修改代码并运行开发工具，也有 IDE 与云端入口。
introduction.en: OpenAI's coding agent inspects files, edits code and runs local development tools, with IDE and cloud entry points.

introduction.zh: 它的价值应通过实际任务范围、权限、测试结果和人工审查来判断，而不是把模型名称当作交付保证。
introduction.en: Its value should be judged through task scope, permissions, test results and human review rather than model branding.

significance.zh: Codex 把编码模型能力包装为可执行、可审查的软件工程工作流。
significance.en: Codex packages coding-model capability into an executable, reviewable engineering workflow.

description.zh: Codex CLI 在终端读取仓库、修改文件和运行工具；模型、权限和执行命令可按任务配置。
description.en: Codex CLI reads repositories, edits files and runs tools from the terminal, with configurable models and permissions.

description.zh: 可同时处理多个相互独立的软件工程任务。
description.en: It can work on multiple independent engineering tasks in parallel.

description.zh: 输出应以变更和测试结果接受人工审查。
description.en: Outputs should be reviewed as changes with test results.

description.zh: 将边界清晰的功能任务交给 Agent 完成初稿与验证。
description.en: Delegate well-scoped features for a draft and validation.

description.zh: 用于定位、修改并运行测试验证修复。
description.en: Use it to investigate, change and test fixes.

description.zh: 辅助发现变更风险，但不能替代最终负责的评审者。
description.en: Assist with change-risk discovery without replacing accountable reviewers.

limitations.zh: 能力受仓库、权限、任务拆分和测试覆盖率影响。
limitations.en: Results depend on the repository, permissions, task decomposition and test coverage.

limitations.zh: 高风险变更仍必须由人类审查和批准。
limitations.en: High-risk changes still require human review and approval.

summary.zh: 通过代码上下文、文件编辑、工具执行和测试推进软件工程任务。
summary.en: Advances software tasks through code context, file edits, tool execution and tests.

items.zh: 给出需求、仓库约定与验证方式，查看实际修改。
items.en: Supply requirements, repository conventions and validation steps; inspect actual edits.

items.zh: 以可复现测试与差异验收结果，不只看回复。
items.en: Review reproducible tests and diffs rather than the response alone.

summary.zh: CLI 与云端任务的环境、权限和可用工具不同，不能混成一个运行位置。
summary.en: CLI and cloud tasks differ in environment, permissions and available tools.

items.zh: 本地任务在指定工作区执行，云端任务使用其配置环境。
items.en: Local tasks run in the selected workspace; cloud tasks use their configured environment.

items.zh: Codex 是软件任务产品；所用模型与产品入口分别记录。
items.en: Codex is a software-task product; model and interface are recorded separately.

summary.zh: 与 Claude Code、Cursor、TraeCode 共同按编程用途比较。
summary.en: Compare with Claude Code, Cursor and TraeCode under coding workflows.

items.zh: 检查仓库权限、终端执行、任务隔离、异步工作与审查方式。
items.en: Check repository access, commands, isolation, asynchronous work and review controls.

items.zh: 选择工具前在同一任务上测修改质量和人工审查成本。
items.en: Measure change quality and human review cost on the same task.

summary.zh: Anthropic 提供的终端编码 Agent，可阅读代码、编辑文件、运行测试并在用户监督下使用命令行工具。
summary.en: Anthropic's terminal coding agent that can read code, edit files, run tests and use command-line tools with user oversight.

capabilities.zh: 代码搜索与编辑
capabilities.en: Code search and editing

capabilities.zh: 运行测试
capabilities.en: Run tests

capabilities.zh: 命令行工具调用
capabilities.en: Command-line tools

introduction.zh: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 发布的命令行编码 Agent。
introduction.en: Claude Code is Anthropic's command-line coding agent.

introduction.zh: 它能在项目中搜索、编辑和运行测试，但仍应保持用户对变更和权限的控制。
introduction.en: It can search, edit and test projects, while users should retain control over changes and permissions.

significance.zh: Claude Code 代表模型能力通过终端和开发工作流进入工程现场。
significance.en: Claude Code brings model capability into engineering workflows through the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明其可搜索和读取代码、编辑文件、编写并运行测试。
description.en: Anthropic states it can search and read code, edit files, write and run tests.

description.zh: 命令和代码变更应在用户的权限边界下执行。
description.en: Commands and code changes should execute within user-controlled permission boundaries.

description.zh: 适合在终端中委派较大的工程任务。
description.en: It is designed for delegating substantial engineering work from the terminal.

description.zh: 搜索文件和调用关系，辅助开发者理解陌生项目。
description.en: Search files and call paths to help developers understand unfamiliar projects.

description.zh: 修改后运行已有测试，缩小缺陷修复风险。
description.en: Run existing tests after edits to reduce fix risk.

description.zh: 提出重构方案并由工程师审查范围和结果。
description.en: Draft refactors for engineers to review for scope and correctness.

limitations.zh: 对大型或模糊任务应拆分并持续审查。
limitations.en: Large or ambiguous tasks should be decomposed and continually reviewed.

limitations.zh: 不能将其输出视为自动正确的生产代码。
limitations.en: Its output is not automatically production-correct code.

summary.zh: 可读取代码、修改文件、运行测试并在用户控制下调用命令行工具。
summary.en: Reads code, edits files and runs tests with user-controlled command tools.

items.zh: 从工作目录和任务目标开始，沿调用链查看相关文件。
items.en: Start from the workspace and task goal, then follow relevant code paths.

items.zh: 完成后审查差异、测试与解释，决定是否提交。
items.en: Review diffs, tests and explanation before deciding to commit.

summary.zh: 终端是重要入口，官方同时提供 IDE、桌面与网页等接入说明。
summary.en: The terminal is a major interface; official documentation also covers IDE, desktop and web access.

items.zh: 本地文件、命令、外部工具和远程环境需要分别授权。
items.en: Scope local files, commands, external tools and remote environments separately.

items.zh: 它是使用模型完成任务的产品，不是 Claude 基础模型本身。
items.en: It is a product that uses models for tasks, distinct from Claude model releases.

summary.zh: 适合代码仓库维护和可测试的多步骤开发任务。
summary.en: Evaluate it on repository maintenance and testable multistep development.

items.zh: 准备项目约定、构建步骤及验收测试，减少隐含条件。
items.en: Provide project conventions, build steps and acceptance tests.

items.zh: 对部署、数据修改等副作用单独设定控制，不能仅凭测试通过批准。
items.en: Set controls for deployment and data changes separately from test success.

summary.zh: Google 发布的开源终端 AI Agent，将 Gemini 能力带入编码、问题解决和任务管理工作流。
summary.en: Google's open-source terminal AI agent bringing Gemini to coding, problem-solving and task management workflows.

capabilities.zh: 终端交互
capabilities.en: Terminal interaction

capabilities.zh: 代码与问题解决
capabilities.en: Coding and problem solving

capabilities.zh: 开源分发
capabilities.en: Open-source distribution

introduction.zh: Gemini CLI 是 Google 发布的开源终端 Agent。
introduction.en: Gemini CLI is Google's open-source terminal agent.

introduction.zh: 它面向开发、问题解决与任务管理，使用前需要根据个人账户或 API/云平台配置核对访问范围。
introduction.en: It targets development, problem solving and task management; access depends on account or API/cloud configuration.

significance.zh: Gemini CLI 提供了将 Gemini 模型能力接入本地开发终端的官方入口。
significance.en: Gemini CLI is Google's official entry point for bringing Gemini into local developer terminals.

description.zh: Google 将其定义为把 Gemini 直接带入终端的开源 AI Agent。
description.en: Google describes it as an open-source AI agent bringing Gemini directly into the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明覆盖编码、问题解决和任务管理。
description.en: The official announcement covers coding, problem solving and task management.

description.zh: 个人账号、AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 的访问配置不同。
description.en: Personal account, AI Studio and Vertex AI access configurations differ.

description.zh: 在命令行中处理代码解释、生成和修改建议。
description.en: Handle code explanation, generation and change proposals in the command line.

description.zh: 将自然语言问题转换为可执行的开发步骤。
description.en: Turn natural-language questions into executable development steps.

description.zh: 结合项目测试和人工审查验证小范围原型。
description.en: Combine project tests and human review for scoped prototypes.

limitations.zh: 开源客户端不代表所有模型、配额或云权限都免费。
limitations.en: An open-source client does not make every model, quota or cloud permission free.

limitations.zh: 本地命令和文件访问仍需要明确的权限边界。
limitations.en: Local commands and file access still need explicit permission boundaries.

summary.zh: 开源终端 Agent 将模型推理与命令、文件和开发任务结合。
summary.en: An open-source terminal agent combines model reasoning with commands, files and developer tasks.

items.zh: 从项目目录发起任务，说明目标和验证命令。
items.en: Start in the project directory and provide goals and validation commands.

items.zh: 查看文件修改与执行结果，再决定后续操作。
items.en: Inspect file changes and execution results before proceeding.

summary.zh: CLI 的开源许可、模型服务身份和调用额度属于不同层次。
summary.en: CLI licensing, model-service authentication and quotas are separate concerns.

items.zh: 按官方说明配置身份与模型，确认网络服务的数据路径。
items.en: Configure identity and models using official instructions and check data paths.

items.zh: 扩展外部工具时核对权限和可信度。
items.en: Review permissions and trust when adding external tools.

summary.zh: 适合偏好终端工作流和工具扩展的开发者。
summary.en: Evaluate it for terminal workflows and tool extensions.

items.zh: 开源客户端不意味着模型调用免费或可离线运行。
items.en: An open-source client does not imply free or offline model inference.

items.zh: 用实际项目任务比较正确性、延迟和授权负担。
items.en: Compare correctness, latency and permission overhead on actual tasks.

summary.zh: 自主通用 AI Agent，官方文档将其描述为能在沙箱环境中规划、执行并交付任务成果的产品。
summary.en: Autonomous general AI agent described by its documentation as planning, executing and delivering task outcomes in a sandbox environment.

capabilities.zh: 任务规划与执行
capabilities.en: Task planning and execution

capabilities.zh: 沙箱工作环境
capabilities.en: Sandbox work environment

capabilities.zh: 持久文件系统
capabilities.en: Persistent file system

introduction.zh: Manus 是面向端到端任务交付的通用 Agent 产品。
introduction.en: Manus is a general agent product for end-to-end task delivery.

introduction.zh: 它的文档强调沙箱环境、文件系统和工具安装能力；实际可用能力仍取决于任务、权限和账户配置。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes sandboxes, filesystems and tool installation; practical capability still depends on task, permissions and account configuration.

significance.zh: Manus 将通用 Agent 的价值定位在完成任务产物，而不是仅给出对话回复。
significance.en: Manus positions general-agent value around delivered work products rather than chat responses alone.

description.zh: 官方文档将其描述为可以规划、执行并交付完整工作成果的 Agent。
description.en: The official documentation describes an agent that can plan, execute and deliver complete work products.

description.zh: 文档提到独立虚拟计算机、网络和持久文件系统。
description.en: The documentation describes a virtual computer, network access and persistent filesystem.

description.zh: 应根据工具授权和任务范围评估它能否实际完成目标。
description.en: Assess completion against tool authorization and task scope.

description.zh: 在授权来源范围内收集并整理任务材料。
description.en: Collect and organize task material within authorized sources.

description.zh: 把多步骤流程组织为可检查的任务。
description.en: Organize multi-step processes into inspectable tasks.

description.zh: 生成文档、表格或其他工作产物，并保留核验步骤。
description.en: Create documents, tables or other work products while retaining verification steps.

limitations.zh: 自主执行不等于可绕过权限、隐私和人工审查。
limitations.en: Autonomy does not bypass permissions, privacy or human review.

limitations.zh: 外部网络和工具结果应单独核验。
limitations.en: External network and tool results should be verified independently.

summary.zh: 以明确任务交付研究、网站、演示稿等成果。
summary.en: Delivers research, websites and presentations from scoped tasks.

items.zh: 说明输入资料、输出格式和验收标准。
items.en: Specify input material, output format and acceptance criteria.

items.zh: 查看执行过程和最终成果，对研究引用逐项复核。
items.en: Inspect progress and final artifacts and verify research citations.

summary.zh: 网页、下载、团队和 API 入口对应不同使用方式。
summary.en: Web, downloads, teams and API entry points serve different workflows.

items.zh: 外部连接与工作资料需要按任务核对权限。
items.en: Review external connections and work-data permissions per task.

items.zh: 采用前阅读当前服务、隐私与信任资料。
items.en: Read current service, privacy and trust documentation before adoption.

summary.zh: 用可验收的任务评估综合执行能力，避免以宣传任务列表代替效果评估。
summary.en: Assess execution using reviewable tasks rather than a marketing task list.

items.zh: 同时记录正确性、引用完整度、人工修订和任务成本。
items.en: Record correctness, citation completeness, revisions and task cost.

items.zh: 长任务仍需设置阶段检查与退出条件。
items.en: Define progress checkpoints and stopping conditions for long tasks.

summary.zh: Cognition 提供的 AI 软件工程产品，官方文档描述其可编写、运行和测试代码，并提供 IDE、终端和浏览器工作区。
summary.en: Cognition's AI software engineering product that can write, run and test code with an IDE, shell and browser workspace.

capabilities.zh: 代码编写、运行和测试
capabilities.en: Write, run and test code

capabilities.zh: IDE、终端和浏览器工作区
capabilities.en: IDE, shell and browser workspace

capabilities.zh: 并行小任务
capabilities.en: Parallel small tasks

introduction.zh: Devin 是 AI 软件工程产品，面向代码实现、测试、排错和工程任务管理。
introduction.en: Devin is an AI software engineering product for implementation, testing, debugging and engineering task management.

introduction.zh: 官方文档强调对小范围、边界明确的任务效果更好；复杂任务仍需要拆分、评审和验证。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes better outcomes on clear, scoped tasks; complex work still needs decomposition, review and verification.

significance.zh: Devin 将 Agent、IDE、终端和浏览器组合为可观察的软件工程工作区。
significance.en: Devin combines an agent, IDE, shell and browser into an observable engineering workspace.

description.zh: 官方文档称其能够编写、运行和测试代码。
description.en: Official documentation states it can write, run and test code.

description.zh: 用户可以在嵌入式 IDE、终端和浏览器中查看或接管工作。
description.en: Users can observe or take over work in an embedded IDE, shell and browser.

description.zh: 文档建议将复杂工作拆为隔离的小任务。
description.en: The documentation recommends splitting complex work into isolated smaller tasks.

description.zh: 处理范围清晰的前端、缺陷和测试覆盖任务。
description.en: Handle scoped frontend, bug and test-coverage work.

description.zh: 先拆解迁移，再通过测试和代码评审验证。
description.en: Decompose migrations first, then validate through tests and review.

description.zh: 复现并定位失败，但发布前仍需维护者批准。
description.en: Reproduce and diagnose failures while retaining maintainer approval before release.

limitations.zh: 复杂或模糊问题不应直接交给单个长任务。
limitations.en: Complex or ambiguous problems should not be handed to one long task unchanged.

limitations.zh: 自动生成的代码需要安全、测试和架构审查。
limitations.en: Generated code requires security, testing and architecture review.

summary.zh: 将软件任务交给可执行开发流程的 Agent，并由团队审查结果。
summary.en: Delegate executable software workflows to an agent and review results as a team.

items.zh: 准备仓库、环境、需求和可运行的验收步骤。
items.en: Prepare a repository, environment, requirements and executable acceptance steps.

items.zh: 在任务记录与代码差异中核对实际完成范围。
items.en: Check actual scope in task records and code diffs.

summary.zh: 配置开发环境和仓库权限是使用任务产品的前提。
summary.en: Development environment and repository permissions are prerequisites for task execution.

items.zh: 给出依赖安装、测试和调试方式，确认秘密信息处理。
items.en: Provide dependency, test and debugging steps and check secret handling.

items.zh: 把运行权限与代码合并、部署权限分开控制。
items.en: Control execution separately from merge and deployment permissions.

summary.zh: 从边界清晰的维护、修复或重构任务开始比较。
summary.en: Start with scoped maintenance, fixes or refactoring tasks.

items.zh: 按任务成功率、回滚成本与人工审查耗时评估。
items.en: Evaluate success, rollback cost and human review time.

items.zh: 产品能执行任务并不等于可无人验收地合并。
items.en: Task execution does not establish readiness for unreviewed merges.

summary.zh: 用于构建、管理和部署长运行、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架与运行时。
summary.en: Low-level orchestration framework and runtime for long-running, stateful agents.

capabilities.zh: 持久执行
capabilities.en: Durable execution

capabilities.zh: 人工介入
capabilities.en: Human-in-the-loop

capabilities.zh: 状态管理
capabilities.en: State management

introduction.zh: LangGraph 是面向复杂、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架。
introduction.en: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for complex, stateful agents.

introduction.zh: 它可以独立使用，也常与 LangChain 组件配合；应根据是否需要持久执行和精细状态控制选择。
introduction.en: It can be used standalone or with LangChain components; choose it when durable execution and fine-grained state control matter.

significance.zh: LangGraph 将 Agent 工作流中的状态、恢复和人工介入显式化。
significance.en: LangGraph makes agent workflow state, recovery and human intervention explicit.

description.zh: 官方概览将其定位为 Agent 编排运行时。
description.en: The official overview positions it as an agent orchestration runtime.

description.zh: 重点能力包括持久执行、流式处理、人工介入和记忆。
description.en: Highlighted capabilities include durable execution, streaming, human oversight and memory.

description.zh: 使用 LangGraph 不要求同时采用 LangChain。
description.en: Using LangGraph does not require adopting LangChain.

description.zh: 处理可恢复、可暂停的多步骤工作流。
description.en: Handle resumable, pausable multi-step workflows.

description.zh: 在关键状态节点加入人工审核。
description.en: Add human approval at critical state transitions.

description.zh: 查看 Agent 状态与流程路径，辅助调试。
description.en: Inspect agent state and paths to support debugging.

limitations.zh: 低层抽象需要团队自行设计状态和错误处理。
limitations.en: Low-level abstractions require teams to design their own state and error handling.

limitations.zh: 框架本身不保证底层模型事实正确。
limitations.en: The framework itself does not guarantee factual correctness from the underlying model.

summary.zh: 面向有状态、长运行 Agent 的低层编排与运行时。
summary.en: A low-level runtime and orchestration layer for stateful, long-running agents.

items.zh: 先定义共享状态、节点职责和边，再设计执行流。
items.en: Define shared state, node responsibilities and edges before execution flow.

items.zh: 把任务进度与下一步决策显式记录在状态中。
items.en: Record task progress and next-step decisions explicitly in state.

summary.zh: 运行控制需要结合持久化、恢复和人工介入设计。
summary.en: Design execution control around persistence, recovery and human intervention.

items.zh: 明确中断点、状态存储与失败重试策略。
items.en: Define interruption points, state storage and retries.

items.zh: 恢复执行前核对外部操作是否已经发生，避免重复副作用。
items.en: Check whether external operations already happened before resuming.

summary.zh: 适合需要精细控制状态与执行路径的 Agent 系统。
summary.en: Suits agents needing explicit state and execution-path control.

items.zh: 简单一次问答不一定需要图编排；按流程复杂度选择。
items.en: One-shot chat may not need graph orchestration; choose based on workflow complexity.

items.zh: 用中断、恢复和工具失败场景验证系统。
items.en: Validate interruption, recovery and tool-failure scenarios.

summary.zh: Microsoft 维护的开源 Agent 框架，提供核心运行时、模型客户端扩展和可选代码执行能力。
summary.en: Microsoft-maintained open-source agent framework with a core runtime, model-client extensions and optional code execution.

capabilities.zh: Agent 运行时
capabilities.en: Agent runtime

capabilities.zh: 模型客户端扩展
capabilities.en: Model client extensions

capabilities.zh: 可选代码执行器
capabilities.en: Optional code executors

introduction.zh: AutoGen 是用于构建 Agent 应用的开源框架。
introduction.en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building agent applications.

introduction.zh: 其安装文档覆盖核心运行时、模型扩展和可选 Docker 代码执行器，实际安全边界由部署者配置。
introduction.en: Its installation documentation covers the core runtime, model extensions and optional Docker executors; deployers configure the real security boundary.

significance.zh: AutoGen 为 Agent 运行时、模型连接和执行器提供了可组合的工程入口。
significance.en: AutoGen provides composable engineering entry points for agent runtime, model connectivity and executors.

description.zh: 官方安装文档提供 autogen-core 作为核心包。
description.en: Official installation documentation provides autogen-core as the core package.

description.zh: OpenAI 与 Azure OpenAI 等模型连接通过扩展安装。
description.en: Model connections such as OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are installed through extensions.

description.zh: 文档建议代码执行可使用 Docker 执行器。
description.en: The documentation recommends Docker executors for code execution.

description.zh: 快速验证模型、工具和消息协作机制。
description.en: Quickly validate models, tools and message collaboration.

description.zh: 在隔离环境中运行模型生成的代码。
description.en: Run model-generated code in isolated environments.

description.zh: 通过客户端扩展连接不同模型提供方。
description.en: Connect multiple model providers through client extensions.

limitations.zh: 执行器与模型密钥配置不当会扩大安全风险。
limitations.en: Misconfigured executors and model credentials can expand security risk.

limitations.zh: 需要自行建设评估、审计和生产可观测性。
limitations.en: Evaluation, audit and production observability remain deployment responsibilities.

summary.zh: AutoGen Core 提供事件驱动 Agent 运行机制与模型客户端扩展。
summary.en: AutoGen Core provides event-driven agent runtime and model-client extensions.

items.zh: 明确每个 Agent 的职责、消息类型和交互协议。
items.en: Define each agent's responsibilities, message types and interaction protocol.

items.zh: 按需求选择核心层与更高层协作接口。
items.en: Choose core or higher-level collaboration interfaces to fit the task.

summary.zh: 可选代码执行器和外部工具应作为受控能力接入。
summary.en: Integrate optional code executors and external tools as controlled capabilities.

items.zh: 为执行环境配置资源限制、隔离和可访问数据。
items.en: Configure resource limits, isolation and accessible data for execution.

items.zh: 记录模型消息、工具参数和结果用于定位错误。
items.en: Record model messages, tool parameters and results for debugging.

summary.zh: 多个 Agent 参与不自动提高准确性，需要明确终止和验收机制。
summary.en: More agents do not automatically improve accuracy; define termination and review.

items.zh: 测试协作循环、超时、重复消息和失败恢复。
items.en: Test loops, timeouts, repeated messages and recovery.

items.zh: 对照单 Agent 基线比较完成率与成本。
items.en: Compare completion and cost against a single-agent baseline.

summary.zh: 用于构建协作式 Agent、Crew 与 Flow 的 Agent 编排框架。
summary.en: Agent orchestration framework for collaborative agents, crews and flows.

capabilities.zh: Agent 与工具组合
capabilities.en: Agents with tools

capabilities.zh: Crew 与 Flow 编排
capabilities.en: Crew and flow orchestration

capabilities.zh: Guardrail 与记忆
capabilities.en: Guardrails and memory

introduction.zh: CrewAI 将协作式 Agent、Crew 和 Flow 作为主要构建块。
introduction.en: CrewAI uses collaborative agents, crews and flows as primary building blocks.

introduction.zh: 它适合表达顺序、分层或混合流程，但生产可靠性仍取决于模型、工具权限和评估。
introduction.en: It supports sequential, hierarchical and hybrid flows, while production reliability still depends on models, tool permissions and evaluation.

significance.zh: CrewAI 用角色、任务和流程组织多 Agent 协作。
significance.en: CrewAI organizes multi-agent collaboration through roles, tasks and flows.

description.zh: 官方文档将 Agents、Crews 和 Flows 作为核心概念。
description.en: Official documentation presents agents, crews and flows as core concepts.

description.zh: Flow 支持状态、路由、持久执行与恢复。
description.en: Flows support state, routing, persistence and resumption.

description.zh: 文档强调 guardrails、memory、knowledge 和 observability。
description.en: The documentation emphasizes guardrails, memory, knowledge and observability.

description.zh: 让不同角色处理检索、整理和复核步骤。
description.en: Assign retrieval, synthesis and review to different roles.

description.zh: 组合触发器、任务和人工介入。
description.en: Combine triggers, tasks and human intervention.

description.zh: 使用结构化结果约束 Agent 产物。
description.en: Constrain agent deliverables with structured results.

limitations.zh: 角色数量不等于可靠性，复杂流程仍需评估。
limitations.en: More roles do not equal reliability; complex flows still need evaluation.

limitations.zh: 工具和外部系统连接必须实施最小权限。
limitations.en: Tool and external-system connections require least privilege.

summary.zh: 用角色、任务与流程组织协作式 Agent。
summary.en: Organize collaborative agents using roles, tasks and flows.

items.zh: 将角色职责和交付结果写清，避免多个角色重复处理同一任务。
items.en: Define responsibilities and outputs to avoid duplicated work.

items.zh: 用流程约束任务先后、状态和分支条件。
items.en: Constrain ordering, state and branches using flows.

summary.zh: 工具调用与流程状态需要与模型输出共同验证。
summary.en: Validate tool calls and flow state alongside model output.

items.zh: 显式定义工具输入输出、权限与错误处理。
items.en: Define tool schemas, permissions and error handling.

items.zh: 为长期执行保存可恢复的任务状态和日志。
items.en: Preserve recoverable task state and logs for long-running execution.

summary.zh: 适合分工清晰的任务链和多角色协作试验。
summary.en: Evaluate it for well-defined task chains and role-based collaboration.

items.zh: 衡量每一阶段输出质量，而非仅看最终回复。
items.en: Measure output quality at each stage rather than just the final response.

items.zh: 额外 Agent 会增加调用成本，先建立简单流程基线。
items.en: Extra agents add model-call cost; establish a simple baseline first.

summary.zh: 用于构建 Agent 应用的轻量 Python SDK，提供 Agent、工具、Handoff、Guardrail、会话和追踪能力。
summary.en: Lightweight Python SDK for agentic applications with agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing.

capabilities.zh: 函数工具
capabilities.en: Function tools

capabilities.zh: Handoff 与 Agent-as-tool
capabilities.en: Handoffs and agents-as-tools

capabilities.zh: Guardrail 与追踪
capabilities.en: Guardrails and tracing

introduction.zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 是构建 Agent 应用的 Python SDK。
introduction.en: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a Python SDK for agentic applications.

introduction.zh: 它在模型调用之上提供 Agent 循环、工具、handoff、guardrail、会话和追踪等编排能力。
introduction.en: It provides an agent loop, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing above model calls.

significance.zh: 该 SDK 为 OpenAI 模型上的 Agent 运行时提供了较小且可组合的抽象集合。
significance.en: The SDK supplies a small, composable set of runtime abstractions for agents on OpenAI models.

description.zh: 文档列出 Agent、工具、handoff 和 guardrail 等核心原语。
description.en: Documentation lists agents, tools, handoffs and guardrails as core primitives.

description.zh: 内置 Agent loop 可管理工具调用并继续执行直到完成。
description.en: The built-in agent loop can manage tool calls and continue until completion.

description.zh: SDK 提供 tracing，用于可视化和调试 Agent 流程。
description.en: The SDK provides tracing for visualizing and debugging agent flows.

description.zh: 为模型接入经过模式校验的函数工具。
description.en: Connect schema-validated function tools to models.

description.zh: 根据任务选择 manager 或 handoff 模式。
description.en: Choose manager or handoff patterns per task.

description.zh: 记录追踪并用评估检查输出。
description.en: Capture traces and evaluate outputs.

limitations.zh: SDK 不能替代工具权限、数据治理和业务评估。
limitations.en: The SDK does not replace tool permissions, data governance or product evaluation.

limitations.zh: Agent 设计需要控制成本、失败恢复和人工介入。
limitations.en: Agent design still needs cost control, failure recovery and human oversight.

summary.zh: Python SDK 提供 Agent、工具、handoff、guardrail 与运行追踪。
summary.en: The Python SDK provides agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails and tracing.

items.zh: 定义 instructions 与工具，再使用 Runner 推进任务。
items.en: Define instructions and tools, then use Runner to advance tasks.

items.zh: 将 handoff 用于职责转交，明确接收任务的上下文。
items.en: Use handoffs for responsibility transfer and define the receiving context.

summary.zh: 会话、检查与追踪帮助管理运行，但业务权限仍需自行配置。
summary.en: Sessions, checks and tracing support runs; business permissions still need configuration.

items.zh: 在工具侧检查参数、身份、数据范围和副作用。
items.en: Validate parameters, identity, data scope and side effects in tools.

items.zh: 敏感操作设置人工确认或独立授权条件。
items.en: Set human review or separate authorization for sensitive operations.

summary.zh: 适合在自己的应用中构建受控 Agent 流程。
summary.en: Suits controlled agent workflows embedded in your own application.

items.zh: 测试 handoff、工具失败、超时与会话恢复。
items.en: Test handoffs, tool failures, timeouts and session recovery.

items.zh: SDK 是开发组件，不能与完整工作台按相同产品层次比较。
items.en: The SDK is a development component, distinct from a complete workbench.

summary.zh: 面向文档、表格、数据分析和研究任务的 AI 办公工作台，可处理授权的本地文件并交付成果。
summary.en: An AI workbench for documents, spreadsheets, analysis and research, with authorized local-file access.

introduction.zh: 面向文档、表格、数据分析和研究任务的 AI 办公工作台，可处理授权的本地文件并交付成果。
introduction.en: An AI workbench for documents, spreadsheets, analysis and research, with authorized local-file access.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: 官方列出文档生成、数据分析、演示稿和批量文件处理。
description.en: Official use cases include documents, data analysis, presentations and batch file work.

description.zh: 腾讯公告列出 WorkBuddy 可体验 Hy4 preview；实际可用模型以应用内为准。
description.en: Tencent lists WorkBuddy as an interface to Hy4 preview; check current availability in the app.

description.zh: 内置模型与自定义 API 是不同接入路径，模型选择会影响处理数据的提供方。
description.en: Built-in models and custom APIs have different providers and data paths.

description.zh: 核对生成文档、表格和演示稿的结构与内容。
description.en: Review the structure and contents of generated office files.

description.zh: 检查研究报告的引用，以及文件整理的变更。
description.en: Check report citations and file-organizing changes.

limitations.zh: 授权文件范围后再执行；产物和数据分析结论仍需验收。
limitations.en: Authorize file scope before execution and review results.

limitations.zh: 主要按办公用途归组，具备 Agent 能力不代表它是基础模型或开发框架。
limitations.en: Its primary browse purpose is office work; agent features do not make it a model or framework.

summary.zh: 把办公任务写成输入、处理步骤和交付物，再在工作区查看执行过程。
summary.en: Define inputs, processing and deliverables, then inspect progress in the workspace.

items.zh: 指定文档、表格或目录及目标格式；文件批处理先确认范围。
items.en: Specify documents, spreadsheets or folders and output formats; confirm scope before batch work.

items.zh: 检查生成文档的结构、数据分析计算和研究报告引用。
items.en: Check document structure, analysis calculations and research citations.

summary.zh: 内置模型与自定义 API 是不同接入路径，模型选择会影响处理数据的提供方。
summary.en: Built-in models and custom APIs have different providers and data paths.

items.zh: 腾讯公告列出 Hy4 preview 接入；模型菜单可能继续变化。
items.en: Tencent lists Hy4 preview access; model menus may evolve.

items.zh: 自定义模型可连接第三方 API 或本地服务；配置保存在本地不代表所有推理都在本机。
items.en: Custom models can use third-party APIs or local services; local configuration does not imply local inference.

summary.zh: 适合需要产出文件的办公与研究任务；执行权限由实际任务决定。
summary.en: Best evaluated on office and research tasks that produce files; scope permissions per task.

items.zh: 用同一份脱敏样例比较不同模型的正确性、完成时间与调用成本。
items.en: Compare models using one sanitized sample, correctness, elapsed time and call cost.

items.zh: 整理文件前保留副本，执行完成后逐项核对产物与变更。
items.en: Keep a copy before organizing files and review artifacts and changes afterwards.

summary.zh: 融合代码编辑、项目理解、运行调试和变更管理的 AI 开发工具，提供 IDE 与 SOLO 两种模式。
summary.en: An AI development tool for editing, project understanding, debugging and change management, with IDE and SOLO modes.

introduction.zh: 融合代码编辑、项目理解、运行调试和变更管理的 AI 开发工具，提供 IDE 与 SOLO 两种模式。
introduction.en: An AI development tool for editing, project understanding, debugging and change management, with IDE and SOLO modes.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: IDE 模式保留编辑器工作流；SOLO 模式让智能体规划和推进任务。
description.en: IDE retains editor workflows; SOLO lets agents plan and execute tasks.

description.zh: 支持自定义模型 API Key，并为智能体配置工具与 MCP Server。
description.en: Supports custom model API keys and agent tools including MCP servers.

description.zh: 自定义模型、MCP Server 与命令执行具有不同权限和数据边界。
description.en: Custom models, MCP servers and commands have distinct permission and data boundaries.

description.zh: 理解上下文，修改代码并运行测试、审查差异。
description.en: Inspect context, edit code, run tests and review diffs.

description.zh: 把需求拆解为可验证的开发步骤。
description.en: Break requirements into verifiable development steps.

limitations.zh: 与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 按编程用途一起比较；具体入口、权限和控制方式分别核对。
limitations.en: Compare with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex by coding purpose; verify interfaces, permissions and control separately.

limitations.zh: AI 生成的代码、命令和变更仍需测试与审查。
limitations.en: Generated code, commands and changes require testing and review.

title.zh: IDE 与 SOLO 工作流

summary.zh: IDE 适合在编辑器中连续修改；SOLO 适合以任务组织规划、执行和验收。
summary.en: IDE supports iterative editing; SOLO organizes planning, execution and review around tasks.

items.zh: 从项目上下文、需求和失败测试开始，审查每次文件差异。
items.en: Start with project context, requirements and failing tests; review diffs.

items.zh: 将运行、调试、Git 和代码审查结合，避免只检查生成文本。
items.en: Combine execution, debugging, Git and review rather than checking generated text alone.

summary.zh: 自定义模型、MCP Server 与命令执行具有不同权限和数据边界。
summary.en: Custom models, MCP servers and commands have distinct permission and data boundaries.

items.zh: 配置模型 API Key 与 MCP 工具时确认服务端和可读取的数据。
items.en: Check providers and readable data when configuring API keys and MCP tools.

items.zh: 沙箱和审批用于控制文件与命令；自动审批设置需要结合项目风险选择。
items.en: Sandboxing and approvals control files and commands; choose automatic approvals to fit the project.

summary.zh: 它与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 都面向软件任务，比较重点是工作入口和执行控制。
summary.en: It shares software workflows with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex; compare interfaces and execution controls.

items.zh: 先比较编辑器协作、任务执行、远程环境和团队审查需求。
items.en: Compare editor collaboration, task execution, remote environments and team review needs.

items.zh: 用同一仓库任务评估修改正确性；具有 Agent 能力不构成单独的互斥分类。
items.en: Evaluate correctness on the same repository task; agent capability is not a mutually exclusive category.

summary.zh: 面向文档、开发和设计任务的 AI 工作台，提供网页、桌面与移动入口，以及 Work、Code、Design 模式。
summary.en: An AI workbench for office, coding and design tasks across web, desktop and mobile interfaces.

introduction.zh: 面向文档、开发和设计任务的 AI 工作台，提供网页、桌面与移动入口，以及 Work、Code、Design 模式。
introduction.en: An AI workbench for office, coding and design tasks across web, desktop and mobile interfaces.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: Work 处理文档与数据；Code 聚焦编码；Design 面向设计交付。
description.en: Work handles documents and data; Code focuses on coding; Design supports design deliverables.

description.zh: 独立于 TraeCode 运行，支持云端隔离环境中的智能体任务。
description.en: Runs independently of TraeCode and supports cloud agents in isolated environments.

description.zh: TraeWork 独立于 TraeCode；跨设备下发任务与云端执行需要区分。
description.en: TraeWork is separate from TraeCode; distinguish cross-device dispatch from cloud execution.

description.zh: 检查文档、数据和演示稿的最终成果。
description.en: Review final documents, data and presentations.

description.zh: 从不同入口下发、查看并验收任务。
description.en: Assign, monitor and review tasks across interfaces.

limitations.zh: 主要按办公与研究用途浏览；Code 模式是能力标签，不另建重复条目。
limitations.en: Browse primarily under office and research; Code is a capability, not a duplicate entry.

limitations.zh: 任务的本地与云端权限、套餐及额度需按当前官方条件核对。
limitations.en: Verify local/cloud permissions, plans and quotas against current official terms.

summary.zh: Work、Code、Design 对应办公、开发与设计；各入口提供的模式有区别。
summary.en: Work, Code and Design cover office, development and design, with interface-specific availability.

items.zh: 网页和桌面可使用三种模式；移动入口当前提供 Work 与 Code。
items.en: Web and desktop offer all three modes; mobile currently offers Work and Code.

items.zh: 以具体文件或预览结果验收任务，记录要求和完成条件。
items.en: Review concrete artifacts or previews and record acceptance criteria.

summary.zh: TraeWork 独立于 TraeCode；跨设备下发任务与云端执行需要区分。
summary.en: TraeWork is separate from TraeCode; distinguish cross-device dispatch from cloud execution.

items.zh: 桌面支持本地与云端任务；移动端可向关联电脑下发任务。
items.en: Desktop supports local and cloud tasks; mobile can dispatch tasks to connected computers.

items.zh: 任务位置影响文件可达范围、连接条件和运行权限。
items.en: Execution location affects file reach, connectivity and permissions.

summary.zh: 适合比较跨设备办公与任务交付，不能把同名 Code 模式当作同一 IDE。
summary.en: Evaluate cross-device productivity and deliverables; its Code mode is not the same IDE product.

items.zh: 按当前套餐核对积分与并发云端任务；促销额度不当作长期价格。
items.en: Check current credits and cloud concurrency; promotional quotas are not permanent pricing.

items.zh: 先试运行一个明确任务，查看中间进度并验收最终结果。
items.en: Trial a scoped task, inspect progress and review final output.

summary.zh: 智谱 GLM 模型家族；覆盖 GLM-5 至 5.3 的文本版本与独立的 5.3-Flash 多模态分支。
summary.en: Zhipu's GLM family, covering GLM-5 through 5.3 text releases and the distinct multimodal 5.3-Flash branch.

introduction.zh: 智谱 GLM 模型家族；覆盖 GLM-5 至 5.3 的文本版本与独立的 5.3-Flash 多模态分支。
introduction.en: Zhipu's GLM family, covering GLM-5 through 5.3 text releases and the distinct multimodal 5.3-Flash branch.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: 官方仓库列出 744B 总参数、40B 激活参数的 MoE 架构。
description.en: The official repository lists a 744B-total, 40B-active MoE architecture.

description.zh: 扩展软件工程后训练；思考始终开启，可选择 low、high、max 深度。
description.en: Scales software-engineering post-training; thinking stays enabled with low, high and max effort levels.

description.zh: API、Coding Plan 与开放权重分别核对；权重部署需要匹配推理环境。
description.en: Check API, Coding Plan and weights separately; self-hosting requires a suitable inference environment.

description.zh: GLM-5.3-Flash 是原生多模态 MoE 版本，以混合注意力支持百万上下文。
description.en: GLM-5.3-Flash is a native multimodal MoE release with hybrid attention and million-token context.

description.zh: 使用真实仓库测试修改正确性和多步骤任务表现。
description.en: Test correctness and multistep performance on real repositories.

description.zh: 先核对权重、硬件和许可证，再比较托管 API。
description.en: Check weights, hardware and license before comparing with hosted APIs.

limitations.zh: 这里只收录本轮核验的代表版本，不宣称完整历史；资料核验日与发布日期分别记录。
limitations.en: This intake covers reviewed representative versions, not a complete history; review and release dates are distinct.

limitations.zh: 以具体版本核对接入方式、费用和任务效果，厂商评测不等于业务验收。
limitations.en: Evaluate exact versions for access, cost and task performance; vendor benchmarks do not replace acceptance.
